about: Med Spa Jenny: cartoon brand character of the owner (Jenny Brady, NP) for williamsburgmedspa.com. Flat 2D style shared with ai-avatars cartoon-mia. Approved by Austin 2026-11-17: j4-room, seed 44.
consent: Real person. Austin's friend and client; confirm Jenny's OK before public use. Use only for her business. Any LoRA trained on her stays private and out of git.
style: Flat 2D cartoon illustration in an original TV animation style: thick clean black outlines, flat cel-shaded colors, simple shapes, big expressive eyes, no gradients, no photorealism
character: Med Spa Jenny, a 40-year-old adult woman cartoon character, a friendly nurse practitioner with long wavy jet-black hair worn down past her shoulders, warm dark brown eyes, bold dark eyebrows, long eyelashes, a round full face with a big bright toothy smile, warm light olive-tan skin, small diamond stud earrings, wearing short-sleeve black medical scrubs with a V-neck top
setting: in her cozy home med spa treatment room with a large window with white sheer trellis-pattern curtains, pink orchids, a dark carved wooden desk with a small white lab centrifuge, soft gray walls, bright daylight

shots.scene: standing next to a white padded reclining treatment chair with a folded red towel on the seat, facing the camera with a warm welcoming smile, hands clasped in front of her
